channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Tiny Dutch startup enlists Samsung as backer as it seeks to dethrone Nvidia AI GPU — but Euclyd won't get its inference chip out till 2028
item.description: Samsung joined Euclyd's $231 million funding round as the Dutch startup develops an alternative AI chip architecture for commercial deployment in 2028.

item.title: Sony Music and UMG say Suno's new models still violates their copyright
item.description: In a new lawsuit, the labels argue Suno found a roundabout way to train its v6 models on unlicensed music.

item.title: Clicks Communicator shipments begin in December
item.description: The BlackBerry-like phone also got a spec bump and an impending price hike.

item.title: TP-Link's budget-friendly Archer AX21 Wi-Fi 6 router drops to $60 in Amazon's Early Prime Day — but this deal ends soon
item.description: Upgrade your home network for cheap with TP-Link's popular wallet-friendly Wi-Fi 6 router with an especially generous four Gigabit ports for the price.

item.title: US Army confirms it has 'space control weapons' active in orbit to ensure it 'can operate freely there'
item.description: United States confirms weapons are operating in orbit, while withholding their identities, capabilities, deployment dates, numbers, and intended uses.

item.title: HP's cartridge-free Smart Tank 5003 all-in-one printer with 3 years' free ink drops to $170 at Amazon
item.description: HP's Smart Tank line have proved reliable in our tests, and the 5003 is an ideal refillable printer for the home. This 3-in-one comes with 3 years' free ink.

item.title: What to expect at Meta Connect 2026: New AI glasses, a mixed reality headset and more
item.description: There's a lot for Mark Zuckerberg to cover at this year's keynote.

item.title: Automattic names interim CFO after exec departures
item.description: Jeremy Klaperman, the CFO of the company's WordPress VIP Enterprise business unit, will act as CFO for the time being.

item.title: Y Combinator insurance tech alum Angle Health hits $2.7B valuation
item.description: Angle Health has grown to 5,000 customers and become profitable, by helping small businesses get "level-funded" health insurance.

item.title: Creality's 16-color K2 Combo 3D printer drops to $584 at Amazon
item.description: We're big fans of Creality's K2 line in our tests, and this is one of the easiest ways to get into 16-color CFS 3D printing with a 600mm/s max speed.

item.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
item.description: Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on a pile of cash and a ton of buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from the founders to their own data suppliers — to tell you what they're actually building.

item.title: ESPN wants to break the Super Bowl ratings record. Here’s how Disney could help
item.description: The network is considering how Disney’s intellectual property and massive reach could bring additional fans to its first Super Bowl broadcast. The NFL season just got underway, but preparations for the 2027 Super Bowl began at ESPN as soon as the 2026 game ended this past February.

item.title: Think you can spot an AI-generated ad? 83% of consumers got it wrong
item.description: A new study put consumers’ ability to identify AI advertising to the test, and the overwhelming majority couldn’t tell the difference. An advertising company is challenging consumers to pick their AI-generated ad out of a lineup, and so far, participants aren’t up to the task.

item.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4 Review: The Series 12 Is Closing the Gap
item.description: The Ultra 4 gets smarter about health tracking and lasts longer between charges. But for most people, the Series 12 gets close enough.
